question: All monetary transfers or kinds sent by migrants to their place of origin are called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**remittances**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Remittances:**

 
 
• **Remittances are usually understood as financial or in-kind transfers made by migrants to friends and relatives back in communities of origin.**
 
• These are the sum of **two main components:**
 
• Personal Transfers in cash or in-kind between resident and non-resident households and Compensation of Employees, which refers to the income of workers who work in another country for a limited period.
 
• Remittances help in stimulating economic development in recipient countries, but this can also make such countries over-reliant on them.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **World Bank’s** **Migration and Development Brief,** India has become the world’s largest recipient of **Remittances**, receiving USD 87 billion (a gain of 4.6 % from the previous year) in 2021.
 
• India is followed by **China, Mexico, the Philippines, and Egypt.**
 
• **The United States is the biggest source**, accounting for over 20% of all Remittances.
